acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Host Ira Glass bikes around Manhattan with Gersh Kuntzman, in search of illegal license plates.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Writer Michael Harriot reexamines the DIY criminal justice system his mom invented to deal with his bad behavior as a child.
acts.credits: By Michael Harriot; Produced by Emmanuel Dzotsi
acts.title: Harriot Vs Harriot

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc:
Producer Aviva DeKornfeld talks to Caveh Zahedi about a crime he may or may not have committed, depending on who you ask.
Caveh Zahedi first told this story on his podcast, 365 Stories I Want to Tell You Before We Both Die.
acts.title: Alternate Side

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Micaela Blei accidentally solves a crime that had been going on for a long time, right under her nose, and has to decide what to do next. She told this story onstage at The Moth.
acts.title: Jewel Intentions

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc: Editor Bethel Habte examines video evidence of two parents trying to get to the bottom of a minor crime committed in their own home.
acts.title: Occam’s Toilet
